items.headline: SK Hynix says DRAM/HBM sold out through 2029; Samsung confirms 2027 HBM supply also sold out
items.why: Confirms HBM as the binding constraint on AI chip output, supporting memory pricing power and capex for AI accelerator makers
items.src: SK Hynix earnings call / Seoul Economic Daily

items.headline: PBOC shifts policy-rate anchor to overnight repo rate, discloses it at 1.25%
items.why: Structural change to China's rate-setting framework, a signal of scope for further easing that matters for China growth and risk appetite

items.headline: DeepSeek closes ~$16B funding round at $74B pre-money valuation, Tencent among backers
items.why: First major external capital into a top Chinese AI lab, ending self-funding via High-Flyer; signals China AI financing opening up

items.headline: OpenAI finalizes ~$20B raise (cut from $30B target) at $1.25T valuation, led by UAE investors and Coatue
items.why: Scaled-back round signals investor pushback mid-AI-selloff even as OpenAI heads toward a 2027 IPO; resets private AI valuation benchmark

items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4%, two governors dissent in favor of a hike
items.why: Fed in no hurry to cut or hike amid elevated inflation; rate path uncertainty directly affects AI-capex-driven equity valuations

items.headline: PBOC injects record ~1 trillion yuan overnight liquidity, plus 700bn yuan MLF operation
items.why: Aggressive China liquidity easing supports China AI-equity complex (Alibaba, Tencent) and risk appetite

items.headline: BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley arrange $63B financing to fund Anthropic's lease of Broadcom AI chips
items.why: Marks Wall Street directly underwriting AI infrastructure debt; validates Broadcom's custom XPU franchise against Nvidia

items.headline: Nvidia and AMD to invest $4B combined ($3B/$1B) in Meta's AI buildout as Meta seeks $95B in financing
items.why: Chipmakers taking equity stakes in their biggest customer deepens circular AI financing dependence investors are watching closely

items.headline: AMD secures $20B+ commitment from Anthropic for MI450-based Helios AI systems, deliveries from 2027
items.why: Major proof point for AMD as a credible Nvidia alternative in frontier AI training/inference compute

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 for IPO targeting ~$2T valuation and up to $100B raise; discloses plans to spend up to $567B on compute
items.why: Biggest AI IPO filing to date; compute-spend and HBM supply-risk disclosures are a direct read on AI infrastructure demand

items.headline: Meta announces $95B stock offering to fund AI infrastructure expansion
items.why: Confirms hyperscaler capex supercycle is accelerating, not plateauing, feeding chip and data-center demand

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 to list on Nasdaq as "ANT"; Bloomberg says deal could value it near $2T, trading as soon as Nov 16
items.why: First AI-lab mega-IPO gives investors direct public exposure to frontier AI and a read-through valuation for OpenAI/xAI

items.headline: SpaceX locks in ~$40B GPU/data-center financing deal with Apollo Global Management via a lease structure
items.why: Shows AI capex spreading via off-balance-sheet leasing even to non-AI-core companies - a structure to watch for hidden leverage
